item.title: Gordon Monson: With just one more move, the Utah Jazz can end their nightmare
item.description: The Utah Jazz acquired an All-Star this week. Now they have to work to hold onto their lottery pick.

item.title: Letter: Utah’s representatives voted for the $316 million DHS appropriations bill. Our senators must vote it down.
item.description: Letter: Our own “representatives” approved increased funding for a department of our government that has gunned down American citizens under highly questionable circumstances.

item.title: Fe, miedo y organización: así respondió la comunidad inmigrante SUD de Los Ángeles a las redadas de ICE
item.description: La comunidad inmigrante de los Santos de los Últimos Días en Los Ángeles se organiza a nivel local para apoyar a familias afectadas por redadas de ICE y el temor a la deportación.

item.title: How the LDS immigrant community in Los Angeles launched a grassroots response to ICE raids
item.description: When federal agents swarmed Los Angeles, immigrant-heavy LDS congregations went to work protecting the vulnerable among them.

item.title: Why this Utah university could miss out on March Madness as part of a $1 million lawsuit
item.description: The Western Athletic Conference is suing Utah Valley over $1 million in disputed exit fees.

item.title: Andy Larsen: The Jazz’s newest star, Jaren Jackson Jr., signals the end of the long rebuild and the start of playoff competition
item.description: Why did the Jazz make the blockbuster trade Tuesday for Jaren Jackson Jr. and three other players? Here's the breakdown.

item.title: Update: Border Patrol plans to recruit at UVU and BYU’s job fairs. Students and faculty are pushing back.
item.description: The inclusion of U.S. Customs and Border Protection on the list of employers who plan to recruit at both UVU and BYU's job fairs this week has drawn major attention online.

item.title: Utah Republicans in final sprint for Prop 4 repeal, but Better Boundaries is trying to push them back
item.description: Utah voters who signed a petition for the GOP's initiative to reverse the ban on gerrymandering are being mailed letters urging them to drop their support.

item.title: Utah Jazz trade for Lonzo Ball – but he won’t be around for long
item.description: The Jazz traded one of their new acquisitions for Lonzo Ball, but the guard won't be in Utah for long.

item.title: Trump admin’s approval of Northern Corridor sparks new lawsuit
item.description: Environmental groups filed a lawsuit against the federal government over its recent reapproval of the Northern Corridor, continuing a decades-long saga over highway through desert tortoise habitat.
